Team / Amanda –

Thanks for confirming travel for next week. I put together a short pre-trip safety brief so we can make the on-site workshop low-friction and resilient if there are any local health or security incidents. Key asks below; full attachments in the Drive link.

Quick TL;DR:
- Please review the emergency contact sheet (attached) and add your Singapore local phone if you have one.
- Bring the items on the Travel Health Kit list and carry a printed copy of passport + local emergency numbers.
- We’ll assign two on-site leads for incident response (medical + security) and run a 10-min check-in every morning.

Action items for internal folks:
- Markus: confirm ground transport provider and send driver contact by EOD Fri.
- Laura: nominate the security lead and confirm insurance escalation path.
- All: complete the shared health declaration form BEFORE boarding; link in related links.

Event logistics notes for Amanda / venue:
- Can the venue share the venue emergency plan and the on-call medic name/phone? We need an accessible triage area and a pre-arranged taxi provider for emergency transfers.
- Any local advisories (weather, transit strikes) you’re watching? Please flag those to the group.

Attachments: Travel_Health_Kit_Checklist.pdf, LocalEmergencyNums.csv

Thanks — I’d like to finalize the contingency guide by Friday so we can print a one-page quick reference for the team at check-in.

Best,
